setup_device: set up the compute device to auto-select cuda or cpu for PyTorch training
setup_seed: set random seeds for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch to ensure reproducible training runs
setup_wandb: initialize a W&B run with safe resume support and optional sweep registration for experiment tracking
save_checkpoint: save a training checkpoint with model state, optimizer, scheduler, and scaler to a file path
load_checkpoint: load a training checkpoint and restore model, optimizer, scheduler, and scaler state from a saved file
